arStrings.szText: You are always {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} but take {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%x|]{/c} increased damage as Burning over {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds. While Burning, {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} grants an additional {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage.
